queries.name: pregame_lineups
queries.query: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '8s'; SELECT id,game_id,team_id,observed_at,available_at,created_at,expires_at,accepted,source_key,source_account,source_url,parser_version,count(*) OVER() AS scope_count FROM public.player_forecast_lineup_snapshots WHERE game_id in (2026020121,2026020123,2026020125,2026020126,2026020127,2026020128,2026020130,2026020132,2026020133,2026020134,2026020135) and accepted=true and available_at <= '2026-10-16T03:50:00Z'::timestamptz and observed_at <= '2026-10-16T03:50:00Z'::timestamptz and created_at <= '2026-10-16T03:50:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY id LIMIT 501; COMMIT;

queries.name: yahoo_injury_schema
queries.query: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '8s'; SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND ((table_name='yahoo_game_keys' AND column_name IN ('game_id','game_key','code','season')) OR (table_name='fhfh_player_identities' AND column_name IN ('id','nhl_player_id','verification_status','merged_into_id')) OR (table_name='fhfh_player_external_identities' AND column_name IN ('provider','context_key','season_id','verification_status','fhfh_player_id','external_player_id')) OR (table_name='yahoo_players' AND column_name IN ('player_key','player_id','game_id','season','injury_note','status','status_full','last_updated'))) ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position LIMIT 23; COMMIT;

queries.name: yahoo_fiala_cached_injury
queries.query:
BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '8s'; WITH game_context AS (SELECT game_id,game_key,season,coalesce(game_key::text,game_id::text) AS key,count(*) OVER() AS game_context_count FROM public.yahoo_game_keys WHERE code='nhl' AND season::text='2026')
SELECT c.id AS canonical_id,c.nhl_player_id,g.key AS game_key,g.game_context_count,e.external_player_id,e.context_key,e.season_id,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fhfh_player_external_identities r WHERE r.provider='yahoo' AND r.context_key=e.context_key AND r.season_id=e.season_id AND r.verification_status='verified' AND r.external_player_id=e.external_player_id) AS reverse_owner_count,
p.player_key,p.player_id,p.game_id,p.season,p.injury_note,p.status,p.status_full,p.last_updated,count(*) OVER() AS scope_count
FROM public.fhfh_player_identities c CROSS JOIN game_context g
JOIN public.fhfh_player_external_identities e ON e.fhfh_player_id=c.id AND e.provider='yahoo' AND e.context_key='yahoo:game:'||g.key||':season:2026' AND e.season_id=20262027 AND e.verification_status='verified'
JOIN public.yahoo_players p ON p.player_key=e.external_player_id AND p.game_id::text=g.key AND p.season::text='2026'
WHERE c.id::text='9572' AND c.nhl_player_id=8477942 AND c.verification_status='verified' AND c.merged_into_id IS NULL
ORDER BY e.external_player_id LIMIT 3; COMMIT;
